value.name: Asha withholds her explanation
value.description: Asha has already delivered an account and deliberately waited to speak until after it landed, avoiding any immediate back-and-forth.
evidence: k at five forty-three because she had wanted the account to land without the two of them having spoken first.
Then she stopped talking and stayed where she was

value.name: Devin silently assesses the news
value.description: Devin reacts by setting his jaw and weighing whether what he knows matches what Asha has told him.
evidence: watched his jaw set in the way it did when he was deciding whether what he knew matched what he had just been handed.

value.name: Asha holds her ground in the doorway
value.description: Asha remains in the doorway with her briefcase at her side, refusing to soften or qualify what she has said.
evidence: Asha did not move from the doorway.
She kept the briefcase loose at her side and her eyes on Devin's
she did not soften what she had just said with any of the qualifications

value.name: Asha notices the kitchen and waits
value.description: While maintaining eye contact, Asha notices the kitchen light and cooling mug but intentionally does not break her focus on Devin.
evidence: Behind him the kitchen light laid a flat yellow square on the floorboards, and the mug on the counter had gone the color of cooling tea; she registered both without looking away from his face.

value.name: Devin keeps the door blocked
value.description: Devin remains at the door with his hand on the edge, signaling that he is not yet yielding the exchange.
evidence: Devin's hand was still on the edge of the door

value.name: Asha lets the silence pressure Devin
value.description: Asha deliberately leaves the landing quiet long enough for Devin to understand she is not there to be answered quickly.
evidence: and she let the landing be quiet long enough for him to understand that she had not come to be answered quickly.

value.name: Asha resists rehearsed qualifications
value.description: Asha shifts slightly, then goes still again, choosing not to voice the caveats she had prepared on the stairs.
evidence: Asha shifted her weight once, the briefcase moving a quarter inch against her thigh, and then she went still again
She did not fill the air with the qualifications she had rehearsed on the stairs

value.name: Devin begins to respond internally
value.description: After a pause, Devin swallows and starts calculating his response, deciding what version of Monday morning to give back.
evidence: After a moment his throat worked
she understood that he had already done the arithmetic on his own and was now trying to decide which version of Monday morning he was going to hand back to her
